rows.name:
Zazadan was injured by some monsters and he[XENO:n ]
hasn't been able to move properly since. He also[XENO:n ]
hasn't had any food. Bring him some food.

Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Twin Flamii Eggs[/System:Color] from Flamii in[XENO:n ]
Satorl Marsh.
Collect 5 [System:Color name=item ]Lemon Stones[/System:Color] in Satorl Marsh.
Return to Zazadan.

You helped Zazadan stop his stomach rumbling.[XENO:n ]
But he is still very badly injured...

Zazadan is too scared of monsters now to go outside.[XENO:n ]
Clear the monsters so that Zazadan can venture[XENO:n ]
out.
Defeat 8 [System:Color name=item ]Ogre Bunnias[/System:Color] in Satorl Marsh.
Return to Zazadan.

You have cleared the monsters but something[XENO:n ]
still seems to be bothering Zazadan.

Zazadan has told you that there is a flying monster[XENO:n ]
that also wants to eat him. Kill this monster to alleviate[XENO:n ]
Zazadan's fears.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Sunlight Schvaik[/System:Color] in the area of Barren[XENO:n ]
Moor in Satorl Marsh. (Only at daytime.)
Return to Zazadan.

Now the monsters really are all cleared, but[XENO:n ]
Zazadan still doesn't seem well enough.

Zazadan is still not well. Get some of the Nopon[XENO:n ]
Potion to see if that will heal his injuries.

Collect some [System:Color name=item ]Nopon Potion[/System:Color] in the area of[XENO:n ]
Lacus Swamp in Satorl Marsh.
Return to Zazadan.

The Nopon Potion has done the trick![XENO:n ]
Zazadan is fully recovered.

Apparently something amazing will appear if you dip[XENO:n ]
a Red Pollen Orb into the Shining Pond.

Investigate Dark Swamp's Shining Pond in[XENO:n ]
Satorl Marsh.
Return to Zazadan.

Highmore Caviar came out of the Red Pollen[XENO:n ]
Orb. Zazadan is really happy.

A Nopon called Daboll has asked for some[XENO:n ]
Highmore Caviar from Zazadan. Take it to him.
Speak to a male Nopon called Daboll.

You handed the Highmore Caviar over to[XENO:n ]
Daboll. What is he going to do with it though?

Zazadan seems to know something. Ask him and[XENO:n ]
obtain some information about the black market.

Interrogate Zazadan who is in the Nopon Refuge[XENO:n ]
of Satorl Marsh.

Continue your interrogation of Zazadan who is[XENO:n ]
in the Nopon Refuge of Satorl Marsh.

Force a confession out of Zazadan who is in the[XENO:n ]
Nopon Refuge of Satorl Marsh.

You might find Daboll with the note Zazadan[XENO:n ]
left behind. Ask Garda to read it for you.

The scholar Kacha was carried off by Ignas.[XENO:n ]
It seems there is something they want to know.[XENO:n ]
Go to Exile Fortress and save Kacha.

Save Kacha who is in Exile Fortress in[XENO:n ]
Satorl Marsh.
Return to Godo.

Kacha has been rescued. However, she has told[XENO:n ]
a secret to the Ignas.

Ignas are looking for the Giants' Key so they can get[XENO:n ]
their hands on the treasure of the Giants. You must[XENO:n ]
find a way of stopping them.

Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Deluded Ignas[/System:Color] on the high plateau of[XENO:n ]
Dark Swamp in Satorl Marsh.

Dig up the [System:Color name=item ]Giants' Key[/System:Color] on the plateau above[XENO:n ]
Dark Swamp in Satorl Marsh.

Investigate the altar on the roof of Exile Fortress[XENO:n ]
in Satorl Marsh.
Return to Kacha.

You stopped the treasure falling into the hands[XENO:n ]
of the Ignas. Kacha will explain the altar to you.

You have to make an offering to obtain the Giants'[XENO:n ]
treasure. Collect the Giants' Mirror and place it on[XENO:n ]
the altar.

Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Giants' Mirror[/System:Color] in the area of[XENO:n ]
Daksha Shrine on the Giant God's Leg.

Offer the Giants' Mirror on the altar on the roof[XENO:n ]
of Exile Fortress.
Return to Kacha.

You got the Daring of the Giants from the altar on[XENO:n ]
Exile Fortress. But now you need something else.

Godo is feeling ill and needs your help preparing[XENO:n ]
a camp. Collect some materials to make a bed.

Collect 4 [System:Color name=item ]Glowing Upa Seeds[/System:Color] from Upas in[XENO:n ]
Satorl Marsh.

Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Fancy Volff Hides[/System:Color] from Volff in[XENO:n ]
Satorl Marsh.
Collect 4 [System:Color name=item ]Feather Leaves[/System:Color] in Satorl Marsh.
Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Wool Rocks[/System:Color] in Satorl Marsh.
Return to Godo.

You've collected the items for a comfortable bed.[XENO:n ]
Now Godo should be able to get some sleep.

The Nopon Merchant was almost eaten by a Brog.[XENO:n ]
Make sure it never happens again by killing some[XENO:n ]
of them.
Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Detox Brogs[/System:Color] in Satorl Marsh.

You completed the Nopon Merchant's request.[XENO:n ]
Hopefully it won't happen again.

There are some monsters disturbing the camp.[XENO:n ]
Defeat them and solve the problem.
Defeat 3 [System:Color name=item ]Coppice Quadwings[/System:Color] in Satorl Marsh.

You completed the Nopon Merchant's request.[XENO:n ]
Hopefully the camp will be safe now.

Nopon generally venture out during the day. However,[XENO:n ]
they keep meeting terrible monsters on Barren Moor.[XENO:n ]
Defeat the monsters.
Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Mist Rhoguls[/System:Color] in Satorl Marsh.

You completed the Nopon Merchant's request.[XENO:n ]
Now the daytime will be safe for Nopon.

There are terrible monsters attacking the camp. The[XENO:n ]
responsibility for the camp's safety falls on the oldest,[XENO:n ]
Godo. Help him by defeating one of the monsters.
Defeat 1 [System:Color name=item ]Officer Volff[/System:Color] in Satorl Marsh.

You completed the Nopon Merchant's request.[XENO:n ]
Now the camp should be a little safer.

The High Entia encountered a terrible beast[XENO:n ]
when out foraging for food at night. Defeat it so that[XENO:n ]
he can continue looking for food.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Veteran Yozel[/System:Color] at Silent Obelisk in Satorl[XENO:n ]
Marsh.

Report to the male High Entia near the Sororal[XENO:n ]
Statues.

You helped the High Entia refugee. Now he[XENO:n ]
should be able to continue his foraging.

Rosa's close friend, Gangu, turned into a Telethia[XENO:n ]
right before her eyes. However, he left without[XENO:n ]
attacking her. She wants to find out where he is now.
Talk to Seagal in Satorl Marsh.
Talk to Galba in Frontier Village.
Talk to Atael in Frontier Village.
Return to Rosa.

After speaking to former Achamoth residents, you[XENO:n ]
have determined that Gangu is in Revelation Hall.

Even after becoming a Telethia, Gangu continues to[XENO:n ]
guard the Imperial Palace. He no longer remembers[XENO:n ]
who he was. It is best to put him out of his misery.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Telethia Gangu[/System:Color] in Revelation Hall at[XENO:n ]
Achamoth.
Return to Rosa.

There was nothing left of Gangu's old self.[XENO:n ]
At least now he will be able to rest in peace.

There are other guards like Gangu protecting the[XENO:n ]
imperial capital. Send them to a happier place too.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Telethia Lecrough[/System:Color] in the area of the[XENO:n ]
Great Hall in Achamoth.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Telethia Guarda[/System:Color] in the area of the[XENO:n ]
Imperial Villa in Achamoth.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Telethia Kaito[/System:Color] in the area of the[XENO:n ]
Sky Terrace in Achamoth.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Telethia Donna[/System:Color] in the area of the[XENO:n ]
Audience Chamber in Achamoth.
Return to Rosa.

You have put the guardians of the Imperial City[XENO:n ]
to rest.

The imperial family used to hold ceremonies in Satorl.[XENO:n ]
Perhaps completing this ceremony will grant you[XENO:n ]
something that may be of use in future battles.

Collect the Radiants from all around the world[XENO:n ]
in order to perform the ceremony.

Offer the Radiants to the engravings at the[XENO:n ]
Sororal Statues in Satorl Marsh.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Radiant Pterix[/System:Color] at the Sororal Statues in[XENO:n ]
Satorl Marsh.

Offering the Radiants made a Guardian appear.[XENO:n ]
Defeating it earned you the High Entia Emblem.

There are Radiants located in various places relating[XENO:n ]
to the High Entia. Travel the world and look for the[XENO:n ]
Radiants.

Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Mist Radiant[/System:Color] from the area of Basin[XENO:n ]
Cave in Satorl Marsh.

Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Ocean Radiant[/System:Color] from the area of[XENO:n ]
Central Seal Island at Eryth Sea.

Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Imperial Radiant[/System:Color] from the area of the[XENO:n ]
Ceremony Hall in the High Entia Tomb.

Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Snow Radiant[/System:Color] from the area of[XENO:n ]
the Sealed Tower at Valak Mountain.

You have collected all of the Radiants. Return to[XENO:n ]
Satorl to perform the ceremony.

According to the Nopon Merchant, only those who[XENO:n ]
complete an ancient High Entia ceremony will be[XENO:n ]
granted passage to the upper regions of the Giant God.
Complete preparations for the ceremony.

Present the offerings to the Adulthood Emblem[XENO:n ]
to complete the Coming-of-Age Ceremony.
Defeat the Satorl Guardian.

The Coming-of-Age Ceremony is complete and[XENO:n ]
the path to the top of the Giant God is open.

It is necessary to provide proof for the ceremony.[XENO:n ]
There are 4 offerings in Satorl Marsh. Collect them[XENO:n ]
and prepare for the Coming-of-Age Ceremony.

Offering in Igna Territory.[XENO:n ]
Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Blue Radiant[/System:Color].

Offering at the Altar of Fate.[XENO:n ]
Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Rainbow Radiant[/System:Color].

Offering at Dark Swamp.[XENO:n ]
Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Dull Radiant[/System:Color].

Offering at Basin Cave.[XENO:n ]
Collect the [System:Color name=item ]White Radiant[/System:Color].

You have collected the 4 offerings. It's time to go[XENO:n ]
to the Sororal Statues to perform the ceremony.
